latestVersion.changelog:
ADHD Daily Planner 1.0.0

- Initial release of a planning system designed for ADHD brains, prioritizing flexibility, dopamine-aware task design, and realistic time estimation.
- Provides decision trees for crisis management, planning horizons, and feedback loops to avoid common ADHD planning pitfalls.
- Includes daily and weekly templates, strategies for working memory and time-blindness, transition buffers, and executive function support.
- Offers practical anti-pattern warnings, recommended tools, and supportive routines for good and bad days.
- Emphasizes shame-free, system-based approaches that work with neurodivergent realities.
